cautions: Heat risk is high on this walk: start early and carry extra water.
About 2.8 km on village streets and narrow farm roads with cars.
Stony, dry path on the Sonnenberg; short drops beside the path near the Wallburgboden.
Short flights of steps on the Wallburgweg.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.About 2.8 km on village streets and narr: Circa 2,8 km su strade del paese e strette strade poderali con auto.
textIt.Stony, dry path on the Sonnenberg; short: Sentiero sassoso e secco sul Sonnenberg; brevi salti accanto al sentiero vicino al Wallburgboden.
textIt.Short flights of steps on the Wallburgwe: Brevi rampe di gradini sul Wallburgweg.
